title: Nhà vệ sinh có tính phí không?
englishTitle: Is there a fee for the bathroom?
pronunciation: Nha ve sinh co tinh phi khong
summary: For checking whether a restroom costs money before you enter or ask for a key.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ask near cafes, stations, markets, beaches, or attractions where a small fee or ticket may apply.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Point to the restroom sign or door while you ask. The answer may be a price, token, key, or free-use nod.

phrases.vietnamese: Nhà vệ sinh có tính phí không?
phrases.english: Is there a fee for the bathroom?

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Nhà vệ sinh means restroom; có tính phí asks whether there is a fee; không makes it a yes/no question.

breakdown.vietnamese: Nhà vệ sinh có tính phí không?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Bathroom, toilet paper, and bathroom-use cards cover nearby restroom questions.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi dùng nhà vệ sinh được không?
phrases.pronunciation: toy zoong nya veh sinh dook khong

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Public restrooms, station stops, markets, and small cafes are the places where the fee may be unclear.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Have small cash ready if the answer is yes. Some places charge for paper, entry, or a shower separately.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Soap, hand-washing, water, shower, and toilet-location cards cover the next personal-needs step.
